# Cropper.js 2.1.0

This is the same standalone ESM bundle formerly imported by the submission
cropper from `https://cdn2.mielenosoitukset.fi/cropperjs/cropper.esm.min.js`.
Its upstream version header was verified as 2.1.0 on 2026-10-13. It is now
version-addressed locally so browser tests and production use the same runtime
without an external request on every crop. No version upgrade was performed.
